Video target: remotion.

Stage 3 — Reference art. Template: storyboard/panel-NN.png (+ panel-NN.prompt.md with the exact prompt), storyboard/storyboard.pdf, assets/<name>.png (static, transparent).
Panel N illustrates line N of each verse. Follow the studio intent above for style and image rules.
  mc exec workshop.split_panels image=<grid.png> columns=3 rows=2 prompts=<prompt.md>
  mc exec workshop.build_storyboard
Cut-outs with PhotoCraft only: mc exec intake.validate image=<panel> asset=<name>
stages.title: Reference art
stages.why: Add storyboard panels (split a storyboard grid or add panel images).
